en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a group of people, mostly in period dress, gathered around a pavilion-like structure with ornate metal pillars and lanterns. The caption at the bottom reads 'Bad Pyrmont Hauptbrunnen,' indicating the principal well or spring of Bad Pyrmont. The reverse side shows typical postcard formatting in German, with handwritten text and stamps including a sender/recipient address to Augsburg, as well as a museum mark from 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
